query: Three things: can you build a co-branded video template partners can localize, roughly how long for a first batch of ~20, and do you have a partner event example?

props.title: A Co-Branded Video Template Partners Can Localize
props.subtitle: Template video, first batch and partner events
props.challengeSummary: You're asking about a co-branded video template that partners can localize, how long a first batch of around 20 would take, and whether there's a partner event example.

props.caption: The co-branded film we creative-directed for AWS and NVIDIA's Project Ceiba

props.title: One Story Both Brands Own
props.content: Our approach to co-branded video is to build a single narrative both partners can stand behind, rather than placing one logo on the other's film. A story that works for both brands is also easier for local teams to adapt without breaking it.

props.title: AWS/NVIDIA: Co-Branded Video for a Visionary Collaboration
props.summary: We creative-directed a co-branded video for AWS and NVIDIA's Project Ceiba from concept to execution, blending interviews, use cases and custom 3D animation. It reached over 8 million combined views across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X and LinkedIn.

props.title: UpShow/ChromeOS: Purposeful Partner Marketing
props.summary: We made UpShow-branded :10, :15 and :30 video ads, interactive media ads, and landing page copy and design. They pitched UpShow's value while reinforcing ChromeOS messaging.

props.title: Android: Crafting a Brand New Virtual Event
props.summary: We created the "Art of Control" virtual event for Android Enterprise, with discussions between Google, industry thought leaders and customers like Walmart and the FBI. Our work covered the event name, look and feel, custom motion graphics, speaker scripts and promotional assets.

final.explanation: We haven't published a localizable video template or a partner-event case study. The AWS/NVIDIA film and the UpShow/ChromeOS ads are our closest co-branded and partner video work, and Android's "Art of Control" is the nearest event, so treat all three as adjacent. We'd start by listing exactly what partners need to change locally, such as language, logos and proof points, before any footage is shot. Our Strategy Lead can scope a first batch of about 20 and the timing with you.
